title: New Paradigms in the Clinical Management of Li-Fraumeni Syndrome.
authors: Giovino, Camilla; Subasri, Vallijah; Telfer, Frank; Malkin, David
journal: Cold Spring Harbor perspectives in medicine
one_liner_zh: 该文综述Li-Fraumeni综合征的临床管理，聚焦TP53胚系变异与癌症筛查，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Approximately 8.5%-16.2% of childhood cancers are associated with a pathogenic/likely pathogenic germline variant-a prevalence that is likely to rise with improvements in phenotype recognition, sequencing, and variant validation. One highly informative, classical hereditary cancer predisposition syndrome is Li-Fraumeni syndrome (LFS), associated with germline variants in the TP53 tumor suppressor gene, and a >90% cumulative lifetime cancer risk. In seeking to improve outcomes for young LFS patients, we must improve the specificity and sensitivity of existing cancer surveillance programs and explore how to complement early detection strategies with pharmacology-based risk-reduction interventions. Here, we describe novel precision screening technologies and clinical strategies for cancer risk reduction. In particular, we summarize the biomarkers for early diagnosis and risk stratification of LFS patients from birth, noninvasive and machine learning-based cancer screening, and drugs that have shown the potential to be repurposed for cancer prevention.
abstract_zh: 约8.5%-16.2%的儿童癌症与致病性/可能致病性胚系变异相关——随着表型识别、测序和变异验证的改进，这一患病率可能会上升。一个信息量丰富且经典的遗传性癌症易感综合征是Li-Fraumeni综合征（LFS），与TP53肿瘤抑制基因的胚系变异相关，其累积终生癌症风险超过90%。为了改善年轻LFS患者的预后，我们必须提高现有癌症监测项目的特异性和敏感性，并探索如何将基于药理学降低风险的干预措施与早期检测策略相结合。在此，我们描述了新型精准筛查技术和癌症风险降低的临床策略。特别地，我们总结了从出生起对LFS患者进行早期诊断和风险分层的生物标志物、基于非侵入性和机器学习的癌症筛查，以及显示出可被重新用于癌症预防潜力的药物。
